pages.text:
A copper spray head fed with water from a pipe, tank or conduit, or a bucket by hand. It holds 1,000 mB and uses 1 mB/t while it has any, spraying water all round.
- Farmland within 4 blocks (a 9x9, down to 3 blocks below) stays fully moist, no water source needed.
- Crops on that farmland now and then get an extra growth tick, a small growth bonus on top of moisture.
It makes no difference to Irrigated Loam Farmland's moisture, but the growth bonus still applies.
